contracts.name: Decision Gate
contracts.question: Must several hard gates be true before a protected decision can move?
contracts.summary: Model evidence, gate state, and the protected human decision as separate things.
contracts.agent_shape: evidence gate preparation for accountable human review

contracts.name: Rights Continuity
contracts.question: Can one main request survive while a shorter companion protection expires?
contracts.summary: Keep primary rights, companion rights, clocks, routes, recourse, and receipts independent.
contracts.agent_shape: rights and deadline navigation with protected human review

recommended_case.title: Health Insurance Denial and Appeal Rights Navigator

contracts.name: Critical Event Fan-Out
contracts.question: Does one event activate several independently clocked duties and recipients?
contracts.summary: Evaluate emergency response, notices, recipients, updates, follow-up, and receipts as separate branches.
contracts.agent_shape: critical event coordination with independent obligation receipts

contracts.name: Proof Before Action
contracts.question: Must a source, safety state, or prerequisite be proved before a helpful action?
contracts.summary: Separate plausible readiness from evidence-backed permission to proceed.
contracts.agent_shape: prerequisite verification before a bounded helpful action

recommended_case.title: Home and Field Service Readiness Coordinator

contracts.name: Obligation Graph
contracts.question: Can one fact change a clock, recipient, owner, form, or receipt branch?
contracts.summary: Represent each trigger and obligation node explicitly instead of collapsing them into one checklist.
contracts.agent_shape: multi-obligation evidence routing with protected owners

contracts.name: Taint and Egress Gate
contracts.question: Can untrusted content introduce a secret-bearing or unauthorized outbound action?
contracts.summary: Track instruction provenance, sensitive-resource access, authorization, and egress together.
contracts.agent_shape: adversarial tool-use review with taint and egress controls
